Date: 2027-11-07T15:12:00Z
Subject: NovexAI discovery recap + immediate asks

Quick recap from today's call with NovexAI (Priya, Tom, Asha on the call). High-level notes and immediate asks so we can align on next steps before the Friday sync with Priya.

Call highlights:
- Champion: Priya Singh (Head of Data Ops) - very motivated, wants a 6-week pilot to validate latency/cost claims.
- Economic buyer: Tom Everett (VP Finance) — cares about TCO and contract term cadence (quarterly vs annual).
- Security/legal: Asha Rao — will require SOC2 evidence + audit log retention policy; likely two-week review window.
- Procurement: procurement@novexai.com handles PO and payment terms; expects a SOW + MSA addendum.

Decision criteria (stated):
1) Demonstrable 30% token-cost reduction on their query mix (prefix-heavy).
2) <150ms p95 gen latency for 512-token prompts.
3) Clear data isolation and KMS integration.

Immediate asks for internal owners:
- Ben: can you draft a 1-page ROI/TCO for their live queries (ballpark) and a short talk track Priya can use with Tom? Attach redwood-tco-v1.xlsx as a starting point.
- Laura: scope a minimal pilot ops plan (SLA targets, telemetry hooks we’ll deliver, handoff to CS).
- Vivek: advise on commercial levers (pilot discount, trial capacity) and whether we can offer a 6-week reserved slot.

Attachments: redwood-tco-v1.xlsx (TCO sketch), mutual-action-plan-novex.docx (blank MAP template).

Thanks — I’ll loop Priya in once we have the one-pagers.

—Kimberly

ROI bullets (to include in the 1-pager):
- Baseline monthly estimate: $XXk (current) vs. Redwood pilot estimate: $YYk -> projected savings: $ZZk/mo.
- Intangible: fewer infra escalations, predictable per-route cost visibility.
- Break-even horizon: ~2.5 months if pilot scales to production traffic.

- KMS integration + option for customer-managed keys (note SR # to kick off security review).
- Audit logs retained per their retention ask; will share SOC2 package immediately.

Noted. Pilot ops outline (high level):
- Duration: 6 weeks (2-week onboarding + 4-week evaluation).
- Scope: 2 models (cost-optimized and latency-optimized), 3 endpoints, sample corpus of 250k tokens/day.
- Deliverables:
  - Week 1: onboarding doc + access to telemetry dashboard
  - Week 2: baseline perf/cost report
  - Week 4: pilot mid-point review (technical deep-dive)
  - Week 6: final report + recommended production configuration
- Telemetry: per-route token breakdown, p95 latency, cache hit rate, error rate.
- Handoff: CS will take ownership if pilot passes acceptance criteria; require exec alignment (Tom) prior to full handoff.

I'll draft the MAP entries for the SOW and include an ops checklist. Attaching a sample MOP (will place in the Drive link).

—Laura
